ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and money. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and your image. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between romance and friendships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between family and your career. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between money and intimacy. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your image and relationships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and romance. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1795690270000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up home and family.
The opposition between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your career and family. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.
